newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Bondes rate rises slightly at auction.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Bondes rate rises slightly at auction.

text.p: The rate on Mexican government 728-day development bonds, or Bondes, rose 0.30 percentage points to 1.71 percent above the 28-day Cetes rate in Tuesday's primary auction, dealers estimated.
The 728-day Bondes were assigned at 97.37390 pesos.
Demand for the bondes was 2.136 billion pesos, compared to the 800 million offered by Banco de Mexico.
